name: Volume Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Classification, Reflection, Illumination, Opacity, Rendering Stages
Rendering Stages, Shading and Classification Pipeline
definition: A rendering pipeline that forms images by directly shading each sample and projecting it onto the picture plane without fitting geometric primitives, using local gradient vectors as surface normals for shading and separate classification operators for opacity.
summary: The Volume Rendering Pipeline decomposes direct volume rendering into sequential stages, treating samples as semi-transparent clouds that absorb and emit light, distinct from splatting methods.
